svg.aria-label: Three horizontal lanes read top to bottom: expert and pilot node supplies verified samples and metadata, country sequencing node processes locally and splits Tier-A assembly to three hubs then re-merges into genomes and population baselines, applied node turns them into stock quota, forensic and restoration decisions; a dashed arrow returns management questions to the next pilot
